basis: A v1 training/validation failure: study-outcome k2 incumbent refit AUC 0.66351595 in 134.9 seconds including its audit, followed by a second execution timing out at 45 seconds and replacing it with a one-column definition at AUC 0.54563326.
test_exposure: V1 deferred test evaluation has begun and partial log scores have been observed. This fix is motivated by the recorded training/validation timeout path, not by selecting features against those test scores. It remains post-hoc development, not a new independent holdout.
changes: Retain the current-cutoff train/validation matrices, importance and SQL of the task's own incumbent only after a clean current leakage audit.
Check task, cutoff, prior SQL and complete seed-row/label alignment before reuse. Reject mismatches and all unknown/error audits. No test matrices or labels are cached for selection.

Use those already-computed matrices instead of re-running the same SQL under a tighter limit and silently degrading to partial extracted definitions. Avoid the redundant find_program executability check when this exact program has just run and passed its audit.

Charge every incumbent preflight attempt's full non-audit duration and all its fits to the new arm, even when no cache is usable. Prior published arms leave their common target computation outside measured agent cost, so this is conservative accounting rather than free precomputation.

Bound warm subset work and avoid automatic re-execution of expensive source SQL for a speculative projection. Keep the complete audited incumbent unless a newly validated candidate improves validation.
unchanged: v3 cold search, two-attempt union, explicit audit-error feedback, strict audits, learner, data, model service, three warm model calls and six executed agent tools; new warm SQL attempts retain the 45-second statement limit.
acceptance: Same 15-session completeness and six unrounded cost and six quality gates. Keep all prior frozen runs and all outcomes; run from empty memory and disclose cold and total costs.
